judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner sought the intervention of this Court to compel the Respondents to implement the National Mineral Policy of Sri Lanka 2023 and prevent the issuance of licenses for the exportation of non- value-added vein or raw quartz; Objections based on steps taken to liberalise licensing procedure and prevent creation of monopoly by the Petitioner. Held – Rationale of the National policy is to discourage exportation of non-value-added quartz; legitimate expectation of the Petitioner; Respondents\' statutory duties and responsibilities prevent issuing permits according to their whims and fancies. Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
